title: RecipeBundleResponse
description: The whole reply to the recipes prompt: two buckets of suggestions from one model call. Source of record: DinnerDecider/Models/Recipe.swift (IngredientLine, RecipeSuggestion, RecipeBundleResponse). RecipeSuggestion is NOT persisted; it is produced on the fly by the model. PlannedMeal (below) is the persisted projection of one.

makeNow.description: Dishes whose ingredients are all in the inventory. Their missingItems should be empty.

almostThere.description: Dishes missing up to 3 ingredients; each missing one is listed in missingItems.

IngredientLine.title: IngredientLine
IngredientLine.description: One ingredient row in a suggested recipe. Source: Recipe.swift:5-9. Identifiable by `name` on iOS (id == name), so names should be unique within a recipe.

name.description: Ingredient name. Matched against inventory by the name-only key (trimmed + lowercased) when cooking decrements stock.

hasIt.description: True only if the ingredient is in the user's inventory. The prompt demands this be honest; the UI's have/missing display and the add-to-shopping-list flow both depend on it.

RecipeSuggestion.title: RecipeSuggestion
RecipeSuggestion.description: One suggested dish. Source: Recipe.swift:12-20. Identifiable by `name` on iOS (id == name), so names should be unique within a bundle.

name.description: Dish name. Must be a real, well-known dish (see shared/prompts/recipes.md).

ingredients.description: The dish's genuine standard ingredients, each marked have/missing.

timeMinutes.description: Total time in minutes. Swift decodes this as Int: a JSON float here FAILS the whole bundle decode, which surfaces to the user as the unreadable-recipes error.

missingItems.description: Names the user would need to buy. Empty for makeNow dishes. Feeds the shopping-list aggregation (case-insensitive dedupe, first-seen order preserved).

PlannedMeal.title: PlannedMeal
PlannedMeal.description: A RecipeSuggestion saved to the meal plan and synced to the calendar. PERSISTED (SwiftData @Model, not Codable). Source: DinnerDecider/Models/PlannedMeal.swift. It flattens the recipe deliberately so the deep link can render the meal without the model regenerating it: ingredients collapse to names only and hasIt/missingItems are dropped.

ingredientNames.description: RecipeSuggestion.ingredients mapped to their names. hasIt is intentionally not carried over.

plannedDate.description: When the meal is planned for. See the encoding note in inventory-item.schema.json.

calendarEventId.description: Platform calendar event identifier (EKEvent.eventIdentifier on iOS), used to update or delete the event. Null until the event is created, and platform-specific by nature.
